what: a knife follower on an eccentric disc cam, the cam turned 180 degrees
method: an eccentric disc cam (radius 10, centre 5 off its shaft on z through the origin) with a knife follower on a slider along +x through the shaft, touching at x = 15; the knife's distance at cam turn φ is s(φ) = e cos φ + √(R² - e² sin² φ) (e 5, R 10): rise s(0) - s(180) = 15 - 5 = 10; at 180 the knife is at s = 5, 10 mm in: the tappet's centre (20,0,2.5) -> (10,0,2.5)
